item.title: Lesson 86: These ideas are for review today:
item.description: These ideas are for review today: [71] “Only God’s plan for salvation will work.” It is senseless for me to search wildly about for salvation. I have seen it in many people and in many things, but when I reached for it, it was not there. I was mistaken about where it is. I was mistaken about what it is.
